headline: YouTube view-count methodology changes Aug 1; no search signals confirmed today

SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_happened: YouTube to count view on video start (not 30s watch) from Aug 1 | YouTube将从8月1日起将视频开始播放即计为一次观看
SERP & Algorithm Signals.why_it_matters: 跨平台视频策略需重新基准化：观看数将显著膨胀，CPM/ engagement rate 等KPI口径失真，需提前与stakeholder对齐计量定义
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence: YouTube official announcement via Search Engine Journal; Glenn Gabe independent verification
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence_detail: Search Engine Journal reported YouTube's official policy change: views on long-form and live content will register at play-start rather than after 30 seconds of watch time, effective August 1, 2025. Glenn Gabe separately confirmed the same mechanism on X. No A/B test data or impact estimates provided by source. This is a platform policy change, not an algorithmic ranking update.
SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_to_do: audit current YouTube reporting dashboards | update Q3/Q4 KPI baselines | brief stakeholders on inflated view metrics

sources.author: glenngabe

Technical SEO Experiments.what_happened: CSS `contrast-color()` reaches baseline support | CSS contrast-color()函数获主流浏览器支持
Technical SEO Experiments.why_it_matters: 结构化数据与可访问性(A11Y)信号可能间接影响E-E-A-T评分；高对比度实现无需手动计算，减少CLS和渲染阻塞风险
Technical SEO Experiments.evidence: Jono Alderson RT of web standards announcement on X
Technical SEO Experiments.evidence_detail: Jono Alderson amplified announcement that CSS `contrast-color()` is now available, which automatically computes accessible contrast color from any input color. No browser version matrix or caniuse data cited in source. Alderson's track record on technical standards is strong, but this is a social amplification without original testing.
Technical SEO Experiments.what_to_do: audit color-contrast implementation | test `contrast-color()` on design system components | validate with Lighthouse A11Y scores

sources.name: jonoalderson
sources.excerpt: RT by @jonoalderson: #1. The web just got a little more intelligent. 🤟 Meet `contrast-color()`: You give it any color; i
sources.author: jonoalderson

Unconfirmed Watchlist.what_happened: Glenn Gabe: Google logging issue confirmed, not algorithm update | Glenn Gabe确认Google仅为日志问题，非算法更新
Unconfirmed Watchlist.why_it_matters: 近期流量波动可能被误判为排名惩罚或gain；专家应优先排查数据管道完整性，避免对site做不必要的反向优化
Unconfirmed Watchlist.evidence: Barry Schwartz reporting + Glenn Gabe confirmation on X
Unconfirmed Watchlist.evidence_detail: Barry Schwartz (rustybrick) identified a Google logging issue affecting data reporting; Glenn Gabe confirmed 'Like I thought, it's just a logging issue.' No details on which properties, date ranges, or metric types affected. No Google Search Status Dashboard entry cited. Treat as diagnostic reminder rather than incident requiring action.
Unconfirmed Watchlist.what_to_do: cross-check Search Console data with GA4/server logs before concluding algorithm impact

sources.name: glenngabe
sources.excerpt: Like I thought, it's just a logging issue.... Like I thought, it's just a logging issue... Barry Schwartz (@rustybrick)
sources.author: glenngabe

Today's Action Items.what_to_do: YouTube: Update view KPI baselines before Aug 1 policy change takes effect
Google: Verify any recent traffic anomalies against server logs before attributing to algorithm
